description: This file defines a class 'InvokeDispatcher' that handles various commands in an Android application. It maps command strings to specific handler functions responsible for executing actions such as canvas manipulation, camera operations, location retrieval, device info, notifications, system commands, and more. It also includes utility functions for checking feature availability and error handling related to SMS search capabilities.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcher
classes.description: Central class responsible for dispatching commands received as strings with parameters, routing them to appropriate handlers, and managing feature availability and error responses.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main method to process incoming command strings with optional parameters, routing to specific handler functions or returning errors for invalid commands.

methods.name: withReadyA2ui
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI component is ready before executing UI-related commands, attempting to initialize or re-initialize as necessary.

methods.name: withCanvasAvailable
methods.description: Wraps execution of canvas-related commands with error handling in case of canvas unavailability.

methods.name: availabilityError
methods.description: Checks feature availability based on current settings or device capabilities, returning an error result if a feature is unavailable.
